steps.name: count
steps.expr: const qs=[...document.querySelectorAll('.qz')]; return qs.length+' questions · types '+JSON.stringify(qs.reduce((a,q)=>(a[q.dataset.type]=(a[q.dataset.type]||0)+1,a),{}))+' · figs '+[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-fig]')].map(f=>f.dataset.fig+':'+(f.querySelector('svg,table,button')?'ok':'EMPTY')).join(',')+' · progress: '+document.getElementById('quiz-progress').textContent

steps.name: details
steps.expr: const d=[...document.querySelectorAll('details.more')]; const empty=d.filter(x=>x.querySelector('.prose').textContent.trim().length<20).length; d.forEach(x=>x.open=true); return d.length+' folds, '+empty+' empty; opened all'

steps.name: svg text clipping
steps.expr: const bad=[]; document.querySelectorAll('svg').forEach((s,si)=>{ const vb=s.viewBox.baseVal; if(!vb||!vb.width) return; s.querySelectorAll('text').forEach(t=>{ if(t.getAttribute('transform')) return; let b; try{b=t.getBBox();}catch(e){return;} if(b.width===0) return; if(b.x<-1||b.y<-1||b.x+b.width>vb.width+1||b.y+b.height>vb.height+1) bad.push((s.closest('[id]')||{id:'svg'+si}).id+': "'+t.textContent.slice(0,30)+'" '+Math.round(b.x)+','+Math.round(b.y)+' '+Math.round(b.width)+'x'+Math.round(b.height)+' in '+vb.width+'x'+vb.height); }); }); return bad.length? bad.slice(0,25).join(' | ') : 'no clipped text'

steps.name: metrics vs python
steps.expr: const c=JSON.parse(document.getElementById('lecture-data').textContent).metric_cases; let worst=0, bad=[]; c.forEach((x,i)=>{const m=QUIZ.metrics(x.rels,x.k,x.R); for(const k in x.want){const d=Math.abs(m[k]-x.want[k]); worst=Math.max(worst,d); if(d>1e-9) bad.push(i+':'+k);}}); return (bad.length?'MISMATCH '+bad.join(','):'✓')+' '+c.length+' cases, max |Δ| '+worst.toExponential(1)

steps.name: ivf vs python
steps.expr: const L=JSON.parse(document.getElementById('lecture-data').textContent).ivf; let n=0, bad=[]; L.presets.forEach((q,i)=>L.preset_found[i].forEach((want,j)=>{n++; const got=QUIZ.ivfSearch(q,j+1).found.slice().sort((a,b)=>a-b); if(JSON.stringify(got)!==JSON.stringify(want)) bad.push(i+'/'+(j+1));})); return (bad.length?'MISMATCH '+bad.join(' '):'✓')+' '+n+' (query, n_probe) pairs'

steps.name: pool toggle
steps.expr: const f=document.querySelector('[data-fig="pool"]'); const a=f.querySelector('.fig-stat').textContent; f.querySelector('button').click(); const b=f.querySelector('.fig-stat').textContent; f.querySelector('button').click(); return a+' → '+b

steps.name: inbatch toggle
steps.expr: const f=document.querySelector('[data-fig="inbatch"]'); f.querySelector('button').click(); const n=f.querySelectorAll('rect').length; f.querySelector('button').click(); return n+' cells with hard negatives, '+f.querySelectorAll('rect').length+' without'

steps.name: prefix toggle
steps.expr: const f=document.querySelector('[data-fig="prefix"]'); f.querySelectorAll('button')[1].click(); const n=f.querySelectorAll('line').length; f.querySelectorAll('button')[0].click(); return n+' neighbour lines'

steps.name: metric tabs
steps.expr: const f=document.querySelector('[data-fig="metrics"]'); const out=[]; f.querySelectorAll('.mt-tabs button').forEach(b=>{b.click(); const vis=[...document.querySelectorAll('.mt-desc')].filter(d=>!d.hidden).map(d=>d.dataset.m); out.push(f.querySelector('.mt-live .v').textContent+' ['+vis+']');}); f.querySelector('.mt-tabs button').click(); f.querySelector('.mt-rank button').click(); const after=f.querySelector('.mt-live .v').textContent; for(let i=0;i<3;i++) f.querySelector('.mt-rank button').click(); return out.join(' | ')+' || after a click: '+after

steps.name: sliders
steps.expr: const set=(fig,v)=>{const i=document.querySelector('[data-fig="'+fig+'"] input[type=range]'); i.value=v; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); return document.querySelector('[data-fig="'+fig+'"] .fig-stat').textContent;}; const a=set('rrfw','0'), c=set('ivf','4'); set('rrfw','60'); set('ivf','1'); return a+' || '+c

steps.name: point encoders
steps.expr: const h=document.querySelector('.qz[data-q="q-enc"]'); ['cross'].forEach(k=>h.querySelector('[data-pick="'+k+'"]').dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true}))); const c=h.querySelector('.qz-check'); if(c) c.click(); return h.querySelector('.qz-verdict').textContent

steps.name: fill metrics
steps.expr: const h=document.querySelector('.qz[data-q="q-metrics"]'); const v={p3:'0.333',rr:'0.5',ap:'0.5',ndcg:'0.651'}; h.querySelectorAll('input').forEach(i=>{const id=i.dataset.blank; i.value=v[id]||''; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));}); const c=h.querySelector('.qz-check'); if(c) c.click(); return h.querySelector('.qz-verdict').textContent

steps.name: bm25 sliders
steps.expr: const f=document.querySelector('[data-fig="bm25"]'); const s=f.querySelector('[data-s="k1"]'); s.value='0'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); return f.querySelector('[data-v="k1"]').textContent+' '+f.querySelectorAll('polyline').length+' lines'

steps.name: answer all
steps.expr: document.querySelectorAll('.qz').forEach(h=>{ if(h.classList.contains('done')) return; const t=h.dataset.type; if(t==='pick'||t==='point'){h.querySelectorAll('.qz-opts button')[0].click(); const c=h.querySelector('.qz-check'); if(c){c.click();}} else if(t==='sort'){h.querySelectorAll('table.qz-sort tr').forEach(tr=>tr.querySelector('button').click()); h.querySelector('.qz-check').click();} else if(t==='fill'){h.querySelectorAll('input.qz-blank').forEach(i=>{i.value='x'; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));}); h.querySelector('.qz-check').click();} else {h.querySelector('.qz-check').click();} }); return document.getElementById('quiz-progress').textContent
